statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms
The patient has diagnosis code I48.0
The patient has diagnosis code G45.9
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
